Evidence record c10-78b39403 (codebase-verifiable): `tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_primary_workflow_heldout.py::test_current_operator_docs_lead_with_bridge_and_retain_legacy_mapping` reads the shipped current docs and asserts canonical `rebar bridge preview` / `rebar bridge sync` plus the retained legacy mapping. `tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py` validates the generated CLI reference. The code-review commit itself contains `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/cli-reference.md`, `docs/jira-sync-setup.md`, and `docs/release-notes.md`; release notes lines 11-29 state the primary vocabulary, old defaults, retained `--mode`/`--filter-local-ids`, and the exact workflow mapping. The focused command covering both files passed as part of 47/47 tests after merge. CI run 31283137439 also passed CLI-reference drift, docs index completeness, ADR-number bijection, and ADR-index drift.

Evidence record c11-373f748a (codebase-verifiable): legacy callers are proven through real compatibility entrypoints, not assumed. `test_bridge_cli_heldout.py::test_legacy_reconcile_keeps_dry_run_default` and `test_cli.py::test_reconcile_intercepted_dry_run_default` prove old `rebar reconcile` remains dry-run. `test_bridge_request_heldout.py::test_primary_and_legacy_routes_preserve_distinct_engine_defaults` proves direct-engine legacy invocation remains live. The full `test_reconcile_filter.py` proves legacy `--filter-local-ids` still parses and post-filters writes. `test_bridge_primary_workflow_heldout.py::test_workflow_maps_every_rollback_setting_to_the_continuous_command` plus the full `test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py` prove the current workflow mapping and every existing exit mapping. The exact focused command for these evidence nodes passed 47/47 after merge; the full CI matrix passed 15/15 jobs. Older checked-out workflow revisions continue invoking the retained `rebar reconcile --mode ...` adapter implemented in `_cli/__init__.py` and `request.py`.
